implementations.code: export function heapSort(a: readonly number[]): number[] { const arr = [...a]; const n = arr.length; const siftDown = (start, end) => { let root = start; while (root * 2 + 1 <= end) { let child = root * 2 + 1; if (child + 1 <= end && arr[child] < arr[child + 1]) child += 1; if (arr[root] < arr[child]) { [arr[root], arr[child]] = [arr[child], arr[root]]; root = child; } else return; } }; for (let start = Math.floor((n - 2) / 2); start >= 0; start--) siftDown(start, n - 1); for (let end = n - 1; end > 0; end--) { [arr[0], arr[end]] = [arr[end], arr[0]]; siftDown(0, end - 1); } return arr; }

implementations.name: heap_sort
implementations.summary: Build a max-heap in place, then swap the root to the end and re-sift the remaining prefix.
implementations.vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { function siftDown(start, end) { let root = start; for (;;) { const left = 2 * root + 1; if (left > end) return; const right = left + 1; let largest = root; a.cursor('root', root); if (a.compare(largest, left) < 0) largest = left; if (right <= end && a.compare(largest, right) < 0) largest = right; if (largest === root) return; a.swap(root, largest); root = largest; } } const n = a.length; if (n < 2) { a.markSorted(); return; } for (let start = Math.floor(n / 2) - 1; start >= 0; start--) siftDown(start, n - 1); for (let end = n - 1; end >= 1; end--) { a.swap(0, end); a.mark(end, 'sorted'); siftDown(0, end - 1); } a.markSorted(); } })

implementations.vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { function qs(lo, hi) { if (lo >= hi) return; const pivotIdx = lo; a.mark(pivotIdx, 'pivot'); let store = lo + 1; for (let i = lo + 1; i <= hi; i++) { a.cursor('i', i); if (a.compare(i, pivotIdx) < 0) { a.swap(i, store); store++; } } a.swap(lo, store - 1); a.mark(store - 1, 'placed'); qs(lo, store - 2); qs(store, hi); } qs(0, a.length - 1); a.markSorted(); } })
